notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give a creature you control haste.
description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Give the Fractal token haste.
Activate The Pride of Hull Clade by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting the Fractal.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Fractal token.
The Fractal triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its toughness.
